+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import inspect
+import typing as t
+
+from .globals import resolve_color_default
+
+
+def exact_pager_text(
+    text_or_generator: cabc.Iterable[str] | t.Callable[[], cabc.Iterable[str]] | str,
+    color: bool | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Show text via an environment specific pager on stdout, exactly as
+    given. This behaves like :func:`~click.echo_via_pager`, except that no
+    trailing newline is appended, so the end-of-file newline state of the
+    text is preserved.
+
+    :param text_or_generator: the text to page, or alternatively, a
+                              generator emitting the text to page.
+    :param color: controls if the pager supports ANSI colors or not.  The
+                  default is autodetection.
+    """
+    color = resolve_color_default(color)
+
+    if inspect.isgeneratorfunction(text_or_generator):
+        i = t.cast("t.Callable[[], cabc.Iterable[str]]", text_or_generator)()
+    elif isinstance(text_or_generator, str):
+        i = [text_or_generator]
+    else:
+        i = iter(t.cast("cabc.Iterable[str]", text_or_generator))
+
+    # convert every element of i to a text type if necessary
+    text_generator = (el if isinstance(el, str) else str(el) for el in i)
+
+    from ._termui_impl import pager
+
+    return pager(text_generator, color)

@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click._termui_impl
+from click.exact_pager_text import exact_pager_text
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def captured(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+
+    def fake_pager(generator, color=None):
+        calls.append(("".join(generator), color))
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click._termui_impl, "pager", fake_pager)
+    return calls
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("value", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("", ""),
+        ("abc", "abc"),
+        ("abc\n", "abc\n"),
+        (["a", "b\n"], "ab\n"),
+        ([], ""),
+        ([1, 2], "12"),
+        ((x for x in ("x", "y")), "xy"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_no_trailing_newline_added(captured, value, expected):
+    exact_pager_text(value)
+    assert captured == [(expected, captured[0][1])]
+
+
+def test_generator_function(captured):
+    def gen():
+        yield "a"
+        yield "b"
+
+    exact_pager_text(gen, color=True)
+    assert captured == [("ab", True)]
+
+
+def test_generator_error_propagates(captured):
+    def gen():
+        yield "a"
+        raise RuntimeError("fail")
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        exact_pager_text(gen)
+
+
+def test_real_pager_output(monkeypatch, capfd):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click._termui_impl, "isatty", lambda x: False)
+    exact_pager_text("no newline")
+    out, _ = capfd.readouterr()
+    assert out == "no newline"
